ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels occupying approximately 75-80% of the visible surface; low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central notch region and along perimeter edges; macro-level ratio approximately 4:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white pixel regions across lateral lobes. Central black fan-shaped geometric blob at the median notch with a radial, feathered boundary. Distinct linear black pixel clusters located on the mid-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 55-degree interior angle; vertical depth approximately 15-20% of total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations observed along the entire trailing boundary; irregular peaks and valleys more pronounced on the inner trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges tapering to acute distal tips; trailing edges exhibit a complex, irregular trajectory with overall concavity from tips toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of high-intensity, rough-textured pixel groups at the distal tip of the left lobe; scattered circular low-intensity spots observed near the lower-center insertion point.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three prominent, near-parallel dark linear pixel-tracks (rake marks) oriented vertically/diagonally on the upper-mid region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear rake-mark scarring on the left lobe; visible barnacle encrustations on the distal extremity of the left lobe; irregular traumatic loss of tissue along the trailing edge margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Diffuse 'splatter' or 'feathered' pixel transition pattern at the boundary between the central black pigmentation and the lateral white lobes.
